name: filesystem
description: MCP server for filesystem operations - read/write files, search, and directory management

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read complete contents of a file from allowed directories

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create new file or overwrite existing with content

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Make selective edits using advanced pattern matching

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create new directory or ensure it exists

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List directory contents with [FILE] or [DIR] markers

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files/directories matching pattern

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get metadata about file or directory

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: List all directories the server can access

notes: Filesystem server provides safe, sandboxed access to project files
Respects .gitignore and excludes node_modules by default
Use for project file management, code analysis, and documentation
Referenced in 3-deep-dive.md for Claude Code integration
